Environment Level Design

In this module you will engage in the creation of a realistic and convincing environment for games. You will take level layouts through from concept to completion following industry-standard software. You will learn about model placement for environments, looking at specific techniques and theories in current video game environment production.

Learning Objectives:

+  Show creativity in the use of game related assets for use in real time game environments.

+  Effectively use graphical assets and animation to create a strong sense of place.

+  Identify and compare game relevant film techniques to create strong unified aesthetics.
